Applications must be submitted online on or before 13-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Bodh Gaya Management Trainee cum Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor position at IIM Bodh Gaya is 13th September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Clinical/ Counselling Psychology from a recognized institution with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 35,000, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy announced for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor – Clinical/ Counselling Psychology post at IIM Bodh Gaya.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment drive is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of IIM Bodh Gaya.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Management Trainee cum Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Management Trainee cum Counsellor – Clinical/ Counselling Psychology is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please refer to the provided links for detailed information and application submission.
